name: lv_obj_tree_walk

ownership.argument: Root, callback and user_data are borrowed synchronously; a null root selects registered screens on displays.
ownership.return_value: Integer walk result; callback 0 continues, 1 skips children, 2 ends the current rooted traversal. Null-root dispatch does not propagate early termination across all screens.
ownership.callback_argument: Live object and user_data are borrowed only for the synchronous invocation; do not mutate the walked tree or retain unchecked pointers.

provenance.source: Exact .139 AP byte-window and call-site inspection plus source-compiled Unicorn probes; see EVID-RESOURCE-4139-007.

notes: The adapter uses read-only bounded collection/membership callbacks, caps object count and parent depth, and performs mutations after native traversal returns. UI-owner thread only, outside IRQ lock. Host emulation does not prove arbitrary callback safety or physical-device acceptance.
